description: Minimal centered hero with a rounded eyebrow badge above a large gradient-clipped headline, a muted subtitle, and a single primary CTA button. Uses a soft radial glow behind the content and a subtle grid background, with fade-in/fade-up entrance animations. Supports light and dark mode via a black-to-transparent vs white-to-transparent radial gradient swap. No navigation header included, so it works as a standalone top-of-page section.
example_prompts: A clean, minimal hero section with a gradient headline and a badge above it
Hero with a soft glowing background and one CTA button, no navbar
Centered landing page hero with dark mode support and subtle grid background

description: Full-width SaaS landing hero bundled with its own responsive navigation bar (logo, nav links, mobile hamburger menu, login/signup buttons). Centered headline, supporting paragraph, and single CTA sit above a large 3D-tilted product screenshot with separate light and dark mode images. Followed by a 'trusted by' logo cloud section showing partner/customer logos in grayscale. Best used as the very first section of a page since it includes the header.
example_prompts: SaaS hero section with a navbar, centered headline, and a 3D product screenshot below
Landing page top section with a logo cloud of customer logos underneath the hero
Hero with built-in responsive nav and a tilted app screenshot mockup

description: Two-column hero with left-aligned headline, supporting copy, and two CTA buttons (primary and ghost) next to a large decorative image on the right that inverts for dark mode. Includes its own sticky navigation bar with logo, links, and a mobile menu toggle. Below the hero, an auto-scrolling infinite logo slider with progressive blur fade at both edges displays partner/customer brand logos, pausing on hover.
example_prompts: Split hero with text on the left and a big image on the right, plus a scrolling logo strip below
Hero section with two CTA buttons and an infinite auto-scrolling customer logo carousel
Product landing hero with left-aligned copy, right-side hero image, and built-in nav

description: A light, airy fintech/SaaS hero on a soft blue-tinted background: a pill-shaped 'New' announcement badge, a very large centered headline, a supporting paragraph, and two gradient CTA buttons side by side (a blue primary and a neutral secondary). Below the copy sits a large frosted-glass panel framing a placeholder product/dashboard preview. Every element staggers into view with a fade-up reveal as it scrolls into the viewport rather than animating all at once on load. No navigation header included, so it works as a standalone top-of-page section.
example_prompts: Light fintech hero with a badge, big centered headline, and two gradient CTA buttons
SaaS hero on a soft blue background with a frosted-glass dashboard preview panel below
Hero section where the badge, headline, and buttons fade up into view as you scroll
